minimal_zero_secret_probe.workflow_scope: one ubuntu-24.04 job; one echo-only step; contents:read; no checkout; no secrets; no provider access

classification.note: The run objects are created, but GitHub reports zero billable runner milliseconds, zero executed steps, and no runner assignment. This proves failure before runner execution, while the account-level reason remains inaccessible to the connected GitHub integration.

current_github_documentation_boundary.private_standard_runner_usage: Private repositories consume included plan minutes and may incur usage charges beyond allowance.
current_github_documentation_boundary.no_valid_payment_method_after_quota_exha: GitHub documents that usage is blocked once included quota is exhausted if no valid payment method is on file.

required_human_account_check: GitHub repository Settings -> Actions -> General: confirm Actions is enabled and actions from required public publishers are allowed.
GitHub Billing & licensing / metered usage: check remaining GitHub Actions minutes and whether a spending budget with stop-usage behavior has been reached.
If included minutes are exhausted, add a valid payment method or wait for the billing-cycle allowance reset; do not make the repository public as a workaround.
After restoring admission, rerun the minimal zero-secret probe first, then rerun the exact AR-02 builder and independent verifier.
